title: Table from text
summary: Extract rows for given columns from a text.

inputs.text: Order 007 for Smith, J was 12.50. Order 008, for Lee, was 3 dollars. Order 009 has no customer yet.

sections.use: Pull a table out of prose or notes for the columns you name, then render it with rows_to_table using the same columns.
sections.exclusions: No calculation or type conversion: values are copied as written.
sections.limitations: Needs a model context of at least 32,768 tokens (prompt, input, one repair and 6,144 output tokens). Results are model output: review them. Text up to 20,000 characters; 1 to 12 columns; up to 100 rows. Each row should have one value per column; rows_to_table refuses a row of the wrong width (invalid_table).
sections.missing_data: A value the text does not state is an empty string; a text without rows gives an empty list.
sections.effects: Sends its inputs to the model of its role (fast by default) and returns the result for review. With unrestricted ports and unrestricted data, that model may be remote; the Add dialog shows the destination. Label inputs Local only to keep them on this machine.
sections.failures: If the reply does not meet the output contract after two repairs, the step fails with located issues. A context or token limit is reported as such; shorten the input or use a larger context.

inputs.columns: The column names, a JSON list of 1 to 12 strings.

outputs.rows: The rows, each a list of strings in column order.
